_comment: Optional. Copy to ~/.config/claude-usage-meter/config.json. You do NOT need this file if you 'Sign in with Claude' from the menu — it's only for the advanced CLI/Keychain path. To use it, move an entry from _example into accounts.
_how: Each account needs a way to reach its OAuth token. On macOS the default Claude Code login lives in the Keychain (service 'Claude Code-credentials'). A second account logged in under its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR gets its own hashed Keychain entry — see the README to find its service name.
